queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,column_default,datetime_precision FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('ChannelListing','ListingIdentity') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

queries.name: policies
queries.sql: SELECT c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,p.polname,p.polcmd,ARRAY(SELECT rolname::text FROM pg_roles WHERE oid=ANY(p.polroles)) roles,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) using_clause,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) check_clause FROM pg_class c LEFT JOIN pg_policy p ON p.polrelid=c.oid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname='ListingIdentity'

rows.using_clause:
(("workspaceId" = NULLIF(current_setting('nexus.workspace_id'::text, true), ''::text)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM "Workspace" w
  WHERE ((w.id = "ListingIdentity"."workspaceId") AND (w.status = 'active'::text) AND ((NULLIF(current_setting('nexus.actor_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ("WorkspaceMembership" m
             JOIN "UserProfile" u ON ((u.id = m."userId")))
          WHERE ((m."workspaceId" = w.id) AND (m."userId" = current_setting('nexus.actor_id'::text, true)) AND (m.status = 'active'::text) AND (u.status = 'active'::text)))))))))

           FROM ("WorkspaceMembership" m
             JOIN "UserProfile" u ON ((u.id = m."userId")))
          WHERE ((m."workspaceId" = w.id) AND (m."userId" = current_setting('nexus.actor_id'::text, true)) AND (m.status = 'active'::text) AND (u.status = 'active'::text)))))))))

queries.name: role
queries.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='nexus_workspace_runtime'

queries.name: indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.indisunique,i.indisvalid,i.indnullsnotdistinct,ARRAY(SELECT a.attname::text FROM unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=i.indrelid AND a.attnum=k.attnum ORDER BY k.ord) columns,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) definition FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname='ListingIdentity'

rows.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ListingIdentity_pkey" ON public."ListingIdentity" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ListingIdentity_coordinate_external_key" ON public."ListingIdentity" USING btree ("workspaceId", channel, marketplace, "channelConnectionId", "aliasKey", "externalListingId")
CREATE INDEX "ListingIdentity_product_coordinate_idx" ON public."ListingIdentity" USING btree ("workspaceId", "productId", channel, marketplace, "channelConnectionId", "aliasKey")

queries.name: identity foreign keys
queries.sql: SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname='ListingIdentity' AND con.contype='f'

queries.name: no-backfill
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ListingIdentity") identity_rows,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ChannelListing" WHERE "presenceIntent" IS NOT NULL OR "presenceIntentAt" IS NOT NULL OR "presenceIntentBy" IS NOT NULL OR "presenceIntentReason" IS NOT NULL OR "presenceEffectiveFrom" IS NOT NULL OR "presenceUntil" IS NOT NULL OR "channelFact" IS NOT NULL OR "channelFactAt" IS NOT NULL OR "channelFactVia" IS NOT NULL OR "channelFactDetail" IS NOT NULL OR "endedAt" IS NOT NULL OR "endedBy" IS NOT NULL OR "endedReason" IS NOT NULL OR "saleStopId" IS NOT NULL) stated_listing_rows

queries.name: runtime workspace discovery
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM "Workspace" WHERE status='active' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

queries.name: runtime access
queries.sql: SELECT current_user role,current_setting('nexus.workspace_id',true) workspace_setting,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ListingIdentity") identities,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Product") product_control
